messages:
maria: Proposal: add a lightweight "sticky-handoff" for shared API keys. Try project quota for a short affinity window before using org quota to reduce oscillation on spikes.

devon: sounds useful. How long is the window? and how do we avoid leaked reservations?

maria: default 30s. No long reservations: edge keeps an ephemeral lease and reconciles asynchronously with central counters. If reconcile shows overdraw, we emit a correction event.

ravi: implementation sketch: memcache lease + async reconciler on kafka. If backlog grows, circuit-breaker disables leases. Emit reconcile metrics.

ella: console UX asks for an "affinity heat" and a reconciliation timeline. Also show provisional vs settled usage for billing.

maria: rollout: flag per-region, start with read-only telemetry for 48h, then 1% write-mode, then ramp. Alert if correction_rate > threshold.

ops-bot: reconcile-processor deployed to staging at 2026-02-15T11:40:12Z.

devon: billing note: batch corrections daily to avoid invoice churn; mark events provisional until settled.

maria: I'll draft RFC + runbook and attach proto for telemetry. If no objections, devon can do memcache PoC in this sprint.
